Name: (CP) Kel is Nonbinary
Author: ZoeBell
Description:
A simple content patcher mod that simply replaces all dialogue talking about Leah's Ex Kel to use They/Them pronouns instead of changing depending on what your farmers gender is, as well as editing Kel's sprite sheets to look more gender-neutral and adding variants for different seasons (Spring/Summer/Fall/Winter)
Note: When choosing the option for Leah to sell her art on the internet "Mr. K" will still be "Mr. K" as it doesn't change depending on male or female.)

[b]Optional[/b]: You can now HAVE Kel's hairstyle from this mod for your own farmer! (Check the "Optional" section in "Files"!)

[/list][/b][b]Installation[/b][list]

[*]Download and unzip[i] ﻿[/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][i]Content Patcher[/i][/url] and put the folder into[i] Stardew Valley/Mods[/i]
[*]Download and unzip this mod and put the folder into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i]
